nodes.description: Mapping of account balances in ERC20; updated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances, written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased on _mint and decreased on _burn.
Immutable decimals value stored in ERC20Decimals and returned by decimals().
Payable constructor: initializes ERC20 metadata, forwards msg.value to the fee receiver via IPayable.pay and mints the initial balance to msg.sender.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance before emitting Transfer.
Internal transfer that moves balances between accounts using unchecked subtraction.
Spends allowance of sender and transfers tokens, updating allowance with unchecked subtraction.
Public approval entry point delegating to _approve for msg.sender.
Public transfer entry point delegating to _transfer from msg.sender.
Atomically increases the caller allowance for a spender.
Atomically decreases the caller allowance for a spender with an unchecked subtraction.
Internal allowance writer validating owner/spender and updating _allowances.
Internal burn that reduces account balance and _totalSupply.
Read-only view returning _balances[account].
Caller-controlled address used as the mint recipient in the constructor and as the actor in all public token functions.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed inside the constructor before minting, allowing the callee to re-enter or consume gas/value.
Unchecked arithmetic `_balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount` inside _transfer; safety depends on the preceding require.
Arithmetic `_totalSupply += amount` inside _mint, increasing supply without an upper bound check.
Write `_allowances[owner][spender] = amount` inside _approve, the state mutation controlled by approve/increase/decreaseAllowance callers.
Token name passed to the StandardERC20 constructor.
Token symbol passed to the StandardERC20 constructor.
Decimals value passed to the StandardERC20 constructor.
Initial supply minted to msg.sender; must be strictly positive.
Payable address receiving msg.value through ServicePayer.
Token amount used in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Destination address of a token transfer.
Source address of a token transfer in _transfer/transferFrom.
Account address used by _mint, _burn and balanceOf.
Cached _balances[sender] read in _transfer before the unchecked subtraction.
Cached allowance value read in transferFrom and decreaseAllowance.
Spender address for approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
Allowance increment used by increaseAllowance.
Allowance decrement used by decreaseAllowance.
Service name string passed to the external IPayable.pay call from ServicePayer.

edges.reason: name_ is consumed by the constructor to set ERC20 metadata.
symbol_ is consumed by the constructor to set ERC20 metadata.
decimals_ is consumed by the ERC20Decimals constructor.
initialBalance_ flows into the minting step of the constructor.
feeReceiver_ is used by ServicePayer to build the external pay call.
feeReceiver_ is the target address of the external IPayable.pay call.
serviceName is forwarded as the argument of the external pay call.
msg.sender is used indirectly as the source of msg.value funding the constructor call.
msg.sender determines who receives the entire initial supply via _mint.
The constructor invokes _mint after the external pay call.
initialBalance_ is the amount minted by _mint.
The constructor performs an external call to an attacker-supplied fee receiver before minting the initial supply.
The external IPayable.pay callee can re-enter the constructor context or dependent contracts while the constructor is still executing.
_mint executes the unchecked total supply addition.
_totalSupply is read and incremented by the addition operation.
The result of the addition is written back into _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient entry in the _balances mapping.
_transfer executes the unchecked balance subtraction.
_balances[sender] is loaded into the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
amount is the right operand of the unchecked subtraction.
The subtraction result is stored back into _balances[sender].
amount drives the balance movement inside _transfer.
recipient receives the transferred amount in _transfer.
sender is the address whose balance is debited in _transfer.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom reads the current allowance into a local variable.
_allowances[sender][msg.sender] is loaded into currentAllowance.
currentAllowance minus amount is passed to _approve in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls _approve inside the unchecked block.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
addedValue is added to the caller allowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the caller allowance.
currentAllowance is reduced by subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance.
spender identifies the mapping key written by _approve.
_approve performs the allowance mapping write.
_approve updates the _allowances state mapping.
account is the address debited by _burn.
amount is the quantity burned by _burn.
_burn decreases _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
account is the mint recipient in _mint.
account indexes the _balances mapping read by balanceOf.
balanceOf returns a value read from _balances.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only used to initialize the constructor's token metadata.
symbol_ is only used to initialize the constructor's token metadata.
decimals_ is only consumed by the constructor to set the immutable decimals.
initialBalance_ is validated then minted within the constructor.
feeReceiver_ is the target of the external pay call and has no independent behaviour.
serviceName is only forwarded as an argument of the external pay call.
amount is the principal quantity moved by the transfer logic.
recipient is the destination account handled by the transfer logic.
sender is the source account handled by the transfer logic.
account is the recipient of newly minted balances.
spender indexes the allowance mapping written by _approve.
addedValue is the sole allowance delta of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is the sole allowance delta of decreaseAllowance.
senderBalance exists only to feed the unchecked subtraction operand.
currentAllowance is a transient cache used to validate and update the allowance in transferFrom.
